description: Daria knew ever since she was a child what she wanted to do when she was older: join the Siegfried Academy medical corps. Her natural clumsiness could have easily been an obstacle for her. For example, her friends couldn’t count how many times she accidentally knocked over a book. However, when it came to taking care of a patient, she became a completely different person. Her absent-mindedness gave way to surprising dexterity. She was also an enthusiastic girl. She managed to convince a hesitant friend to accompany her to Siegfried Academy. Moreover, rumors say that Daria was a formidable fighter when syringes and bandages weren’t needed. Such a promising student; what could she have to fear in the future?
summon: Show me where you’re hurt! What? Of course I know what I’m doing!
fusion: Fight? I would like to avoid it, but if it’s necessary...
